basic_info.description: Indulge in the pinnacle of sophisticated city living with this exceptionally renovated, view-driven masterpiece in an exclusive boutique building. Perched atop prestigious Russian Hill, this rare offering captures breathtaking, unobstructed panoramas of the shimmering San Francisco Bay, and the city's picturesque skyline.Designed for both grandeur and comfort, the expansive living and dining areas showcase soaring ceilings, a sleek fireplace, and floor-to-ceiling windows that seamlessly open to a private terracea front-row seat to the ever-changing maritime scenery. The meticulously designed chef's kitchen is a culinary dream, outfitted with premium appliances, bespoke cabinetry, and exquisite finishes, ensuring a flawless blend of style and functionality.  A private elevator entrance from the garage leads directly to the balcony, offering an unparalleled sense of exclusivity. Deeded parking, and private storage, all within an intimate, architecturally distinguished building. Blocks to Michelangelo Park, North Beach, Hyde Street, Fisherman's Wharf, and the Financial District, this residence offers effortless access to the finest dining, shopping, and cultural experiences San Francisco has to offer.
